description: This file contains shell functions related to configuring and managing 'xfrm' protocol in a network setup, likely for OpenWRT. It defines setup, teardown, and initialization functions for the 'xfrm' protocol, managing parameters like mtu, tunnel link, zone, and multicast.

methods.name: proto_xfrm_setup
methods.description: Sets up the 'xfrm' protocol with configuration parameters such as tunnel link, zone, mtu, and multicast, and sends an update.

methods.name: proto_xfrm_teardown
methods.description: Defines the teardown function for the 'xfrm' protocol, currently empty.

methods.name: proto_xfrm_init_config
methods.description: Initializes default configuration options for the 'xfrm' protocol.
